messages.subject: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our pricing and standard terms for your requirements.

For this item, we can offer a price of €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some background on our current cost structure, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

We value our business relationship and look forward to serving you from our extensive product range.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels) (1)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your offer to pay faster, your commitment to a binding volume, and the verified price history from your previous orders. As a trusted partner, we always strive to support your needs with our dedicated service and comprehensive steel range.

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €5.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

We can accept the 14-day payment terms and 24-month contract, provided we include the AS-14404 index clause to manage material risks over this extended period. With these terms in place, we can reduce our price to €5.40 per unit. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 14 days net: €5.40 per unit. As an alternative option, we offer a price of €5.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

Please note that material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. Our offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels) (2)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We are pleased to present our updated offer at a price of €5.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Our offer stays valid for 30 days.

We appreciate your increased offer and your willingness to pay within 14 days, but we must insist on the AS-14404 index clause for a 24-month contract. As an alternative option: with this clause and the 14-day payment terms, we can reduce our price to a price of €5.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

Regarding your volume commitment of 23,700 kg per year, please provide the corresponding consumption data or forecasts so we can factor this into our calculations. Which volume can you commit to?

messages.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels) (3)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for the ongoing discussions. We appreciate your acceptance of the AS-14404 index clause, which provides stability for both parties over the contract term. 

As a strong distributor, we always strive to offer you the best service and options from our extensive range. For our current Angebot, we present a price of €5.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

Building on your proposal for 60-day payment terms, we are pleased to reduce our price to €5.30 per unit under an alternative option featuring a price of €5.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. This offer stays valid for 7 days.

To fully incorporate your volume commitment of 23,700 kg per year into our calculations, we kindly request that you share the corresponding consumption data or forecasts. Which volume can you commit to? Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Please note that our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH
